reason: I would not pay for an AI job-search tool while I’m a student, and I can already use my coursework and projects to show what I can do. Since this concept is free but still needs my hosting and provider credentials, I’d rather keep using the tools I already have.
objection: I don’t want to take on hosting setup or AI/search costs for something that may not find better opportunities than searching myself.
would_change_my_mind: A free, no-setup version that shows strong India internship listings I can’t easily find myself.
